review_note: Never one-symptom-one-cause. Never a universal parameter direction.

cases.title: Declining biomass
cases.observation: Biomass of a group falls through time or ends far below initial.

hypotheses.expected: Predator diet share or predation mortality rises.
hypotheses.counter: Diet and predation mortality stable while YOY or condition collapse.

hypotheses.expected: Consumption falls; gape or pPREY ineffective; ResN drops.
hypotheses.counter: Intake and condition healthy while catch rises.

hypotheses.expected: YOY or SSB fall, perhaps lagged.
hypotheses.counter: Adults fall first while YOY stays high.

hypotheses.expected: Biomass leaves productive boxes or layers.

cases.interpretation: Several processes can produce the same biomass plot.
cases.what_not_to_conclude: A single cause, or a universal mum/mL/pPREY edit, from the biomass series alone.

cases.title: Poor growth or condition
cases.observation: ResN or StructN outside 0.5-1.5 of initial, or thin weight-at-age.

hypotheses.expected: Consumption or Feeding shows a constraint.
hypotheses.counter: Intake adequate; mortality explains biomass loss.

hypotheses.expected: Temperature or other tracer is extreme.

cases.what_not_to_conclude: That the Growth tab is vertebrate weight. No universal mum direction.

cases.title: Unexpected abundance increase
cases.observation: Biomass grows far above initial (Overview exploding).

hypotheses.expected: Predation on the group is small; YOY high; catch low.
hypotheses.counter: Predators and catch are high while biomass still explodes.

hypotheses.expected: Units or initial conditions look inconsistent.

cases.interpretation: An explosion can be ecology or a parameter error.

cases.title: Poor recruitment
cases.observation: YOY is low, missing, or lags SSB.

hypotheses.counter: SSB is healthy while YOY is not.

hypotheses.expected: Alpha/beta or KDENR starve the curve.
hypotheses.counter: The curve can produce YOY but Spatial is wrong.

cases.interpretation: Adult decline and recruit failure are different checks.
cases.what_not_to_conclude: A universal KDENR or beta direction.

cases.title: Odd diets
cases.observation: Realised diet unexpected, or pPREY and DietCheck disagree.

hypotheses.expected: Feeding diagnostics show mismatch or zero overlap.

cases.interpretation: pPREY is availability, not realised diet.
cases.what_not_to_conclude: That a single pPREY cell should be raised as a rule.

cases.title: Excessive predation
cases.observation: A prey group is heavily eaten or predation mortality dominates.

hypotheses.expected: Predation and the predation mortality stack rise together.

cases.interpretation: High predation can be predator biomass, overlap, or pPREY.

cases.title: Primary producer limitation
cases.observation: Producers look weak, or consumers starve while producers are low.

hypotheses.expected: Growth shows light, nutrient, or eddy limitation.
hypotheses.counter: Producers look healthy; consumer diet is the issue.

cases.interpretation: Producer limitation is a Growth-tab question.

cases.title: Spatial patterns
cases.observation: Biomass in unexpected boxes or layers, or the map is empty.

hypotheses.expected: Layer maps show a real shift.
BGM missing or box counts disagree.
hypotheses.counter: Polygons load and unused boxes are explained.

cases.interpretation: A blank map can be a file problem.
cases.what_not_to_conclude: That a blank map means a zero stock.

cases.title: Skill deterioration
cases.observation: Catch or biomass skill versus observations gets worse.

hypotheses.expected: Catch skill and Compare observed points degrade together.

cases.interpretation: Skill lives on Catch view skill, not a separate tool.
cases.what_not_to_conclude: That the Guide can compute a new skill table.

cases.title: Crashes or parameter errors
cases.observation: A group hits zero, the run dies, or parameters look inconsistent.

hypotheses.expected: Overview extinct; Mortality or Recruitment extreme.
hypotheses.counter: The tab is empty because a file role is missing.

cases.interpretation: Empty tabs and biological crashes are different.
cases.what_not_to_conclude: A crash from one parameter name. The Guide cannot edit the prm or rerun.
